### Summary

Sometimes when there is more than one rust  package being installed (with building - because there is no .whl files) and no rustc installed one of the builds might fail with:

Apparently, this is because the builds will start downloading rustc  and overwrite common configuration (/root/.cargo for example):


```
  #34 237.2 info: downloading installer
  #34 237.4 warn: It looks like you have an existing rustup settings file at:
  #34 237.4 warn: /usr/local/rustup/settings.toml
  #34 237.4 warn: Rustup will install the default toolchain as specified in the settings file,
  #34 237.4 warn: instead of the one inferred from the default host triple.
  #34 237.4 info: profile set to default
  #34 237.4 info: default host triple is x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
  #34 237.4 info: syncing channel updates for stable-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
  #34 237.5 info: latest update on 2026-03-26 for version 1.94.1 (e408947bf 2026-03-25)
  #34 237.5 info: downloading 6 components
  #34 249.5 info: default toolchain set to stable-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
  #34 249.5 
  #34 249.5   stable-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu installed - rustc 1.94.1 (e408947bf 2026-03-25)
  #34 249.5 
  #34 249.5 
  #34 249.5 Rust is installed now. Great!
  #34 249.5 
  #34 249.5 To get started you may need to restart your current shell.
  #34 249.5 This would reload your PATH environment variable to include
  #34 249.5 Cargo's bin directory (/usr/local/cargo/bin).
  #34 249.5 
  #34 249.5 To configure your current shell, you need to source
  #34 249.5 the corresponding env file under /usr/local/cargo.
  #34 249.5 
  #34 249.5 This is usually done by running one of the following (note the leading DOT):
  #34 249.5 . "/usr/local/cargo/env"            # For sh/bash/zsh/ash/dash/pdksh
  #34 249.5 source "/usr/local/cargo/env.fish"  # For fish
  #34 249.5 source "/usr/local/cargo/env.nu"  # For nushell
  #34 249.5 source "/usr/local/cargo/env.tcsh"  # For tcsh
  #34 249.5 . "/usr/local/cargo/env.ps1"        # For pwsh
  #34 249.5 source "/usr/local/cargo/env.xsh"   # For xonsh
  #34 249.5 mv: cannot stat '/root/.cargo': No such file or directory
  #34 ERROR: process "/bin/bash -o pipefail -o errexit -o nounset -o nolog -c PYTHON_LTO=${PYTHON_LTO} bash /scripts/docker/install_os_dependencies.sh ci" did not complete successfully: exit code: 1
  ------
   > [main  4/25] RUN PYTHON_LTO=true bash /scripts/docker/install_os_dependencies.sh ci:
  249.5 the corresponding env file under /usr/local/cargo.
  249.5 
  249.5 This is usually done by running one of the following (note the leading DOT):
  249.5 . "/usr/local/cargo/env"            # For sh/bash/zsh/ash/dash/pdksh
  249.5 source "/usr/local/cargo/env.fish"  # For fish
  249.5 source "/usr/local/cargo/env.nu"  # For nushell
  249.5 source "/usr/local/cargo/env.tcsh"  # For tcsh
  249.5 . "/usr/local/cargo/env.ps1"        # For pwsh
  249.5 source "/usr/local/cargo/env.xsh"   # For xonsh
  249.5 mv: cannot stat '/root/.cargo': No such file or directory
```

Example https://github.com/apache/airflow/actions/runs/23798997617/job/69353921444






### Platform

Linux 6.8.0-106-generic x86_64 GNU/Linux

### Version

uv 0.11.2 (x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu)

### Python version

Python 3.10.20
